title: Microsoft Copilot: CSV and TSV files as knowledge sources in Copilot Notebooks
summary: The briefing passes: the rollout and automatic enablement match Microsoft's notice, and the creation policy and preview Graph automation are documented. It reports the differing licence wording accurately and keeps the unresolved CSV and TSV details separate from documented Notebooks controls.

claims.claim: Microsoft recommends notifying users who work with structured data about CSV and TSV references in Copilot Notebooks.
claims.quote: We recommend that you notify users who work with structured data that they can reference CSV and TSV files directly within Copilot Notebooks once the feature becomes available.

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: The notice does not name the setting behind allowing Copilot to reason over CSV and TSV files.
claims.quote: The feature will be enabled automatically for tenants that already allow Copilot to reason over CSV and TSV files. No additional configuration will be required.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn has no page describing CSV and TSV references in Copilot Notebooks at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot Notebooks" "CSV" "TSV"; Copilot Notebooks CSV TSV reference files license price meter limits admin setting. Opened cpcn-admin-configuration, cpcn-requirements, cpcn-storage and Copilot release notes; searched release notes for CSV and TSV. No matching feature documentation.

claims.claim: The requirements page says Copilot Notebooks users need the Microsoft Copilot or Copilot Chat licence.
claims.quote: Users need the Microsoft Copilot or Copilot Chat license.

claims.claim: The entitlement model is included in the licence required for Copilot Notebooks, rather than a separately published CSV or TSV entitlement.
claims.quote:
Copilot Notebooks

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing

claims.quote: Copilot Notebooks also require a Microsoft 365 Copilot license.

claims.claim: The requirements page lists a OneDrive licence for Copilot Pages.
claims.quote: Users need a OneDrive license and an active OneDrive site.

claims.claim: An Exchange Online mailbox is required for full functionality such as @mentions.
claims.quote: For full functionality including @mentions, users need an Exchange Online mailbox. Users with Exchange On-Premises mailboxes have limited capabilities.

claims.claim: Legacy Copilot Notebooks are those created before November 2025.
claims.quote: Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks created before November 2025 continue to be stored in the user-owned SharePoint Embedded container.

claims.claim: Legacy Copilot Notebooks count against the organisation's SharePoint storage quota.
claims.quote: All legacy Copilot Pages and legacy Copilot Notebooks count against your organization's SharePoint storage quota.

claims.claim: The storage page does not say how CSV or TSV references affect storage.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Notebooks CSV TSV licence pricing meter storage. Opened and read cpcn-storage in full, including current OneDrive storage and legacy SharePoint Embedded storage; it gives no CSV or TSV reference-specific storage behaviour.

claims.claim: The creation policy is in Microsoft 365 Apps admin center under Customization > Policy Management > policy configuration > Choose the scope > Configure Settings > Create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks.
claims.quote:
Select Customization from the left pane.
Select Policy Management.
Create a new policy configuration or edit an existing one.
From the Choose the scope dropdown list, choose either All users or select the group for which you want to apply the policy.

claims.claim: POST /beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors can apply the Notebooks policy using the applyOnce mode and baseline properties named in the note.
claims.quote:
POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors

An active applyOnce monitor runs in the background on behalf of the signed-in administrator and then becomes inactive.

claims.where: controls[0].governs; controls[0].note; Risk assessment; Governance controls
claims.claim: Create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks governs creation and integration of Pages and Notebooks as a whole, rather than individual file types.
claims.quote: Disabled: Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks creation and integration aren't available to the users.

claims.claim: The creation policy defaults to Enabled.
claims.quote: | Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks creation | Cloud Policy: Create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks | Enabled |

claims.claim: Learn lists the creation policy and a code-preview setting as the two Cloud Policy settings checked by Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks.
claims.quote:
Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks check the following Cloud Policy settings:
Create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks
Enable code previews for AI-generated content in Microsoft Copilot Chat and Copilot Pages

claims.claim: Neither of the two settings listed on the admin policy page refers to CSV or TSV.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot reason over CSV TSV files admin policy setting. Opened cpcn-admin-configuration and Configure Microsoft Copilot settings in the Microsoft 365 admin center. Read both listed policy names and their Enabled, Disabled and Not configured descriptions; neither names CSV or TSV.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance controls
claims.claim: Disabling creation hides the Notebooks module in the Microsoft Copilot app for the affected users.
claims.quote: The Pages module is visible in the Microsoft Copilot app, but the Notebooks module is hidden, preventing users from accessing existing Notebooks through the Copilot App.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls
claims.claim: Disabling creation does not delete existing Copilot Pages or Notebooks.
claims.quote: Existing Copilot Pages and Notebooks aren't deleted.

claims.claim: Files added to Notebooks remain available in their original OneDrive and SharePoint storage locations when creation is disabled.
claims.quote: Original storage locations: Files added to Notebooks remain available in OneDrive and SharePoint where they're stored

claims.claim: Sharing links to Copilot Notebooks do not work when creation is disabled.
claims.quote: Sharing links to Copilot Notebooks don't work when creation is disabled via the policy in this article.

claims.claim: A creation-policy change takes up to 90 minutes to be reflected where policy configurations already existed.
claims.quote: If there were existing policy configurations before the change, the change takes up to 90 minutes to be reflected.

claims.claim: A creation-policy change takes up to 24 hours to be reflected where no policy configurations previously existed.
claims.quote: If there were no policy configurations before the change, the change takes up to 24 hours to be reflected.

claims.claim: The Cloud Policy creation setting can be scoped to all users or a selected group.
claims.quote: From the Choose the scope dropdown list, choose either All users or select the group for which you want to apply the policy.

claims.claim: The preview Graph automation uses mode=applyOnce to apply the desired-state baseline.
claims.quote: Create a new configurationMonitor object that runs periodically in the background at a scheduled frequency to detect configuration drift in monitorOnly mode, or applies a desired-state baseline once in applyOnce mode.

claims.claim: The Notebooks baseline resource type is microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks.
claims.quote: "resourceType": "microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks"

claims.claim: The Notebooks baseline uses resourceVersion 1.
claims.quote:
"resourceType": "microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks",
  "resourceVersion": 1

claims.claim: The baseline's properties.value setting of 0 disables the Pages and Notebooks policy.
claims.quote: | value | Write | String | Allows or prevents creating and viewing Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks through Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat and Copilot Actions. 0 disables the setting; 1 enables the setting.

claims.claim: The baseline's properties.value setting of 1 enables the Pages and Notebooks policy.
TCM supports these Copilot settings only in tenant-level policies in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center.
claims.quote: TCM supports these settings only in tenant-level policies in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center.

claims.claim: The target setting must not be configured in any group-level policy when using this TCM automation.
claims.quote: Before using TCM, ensure that the target setting isn't configured in any group-level policy in that admin center. If it is, monitoring, snapshots, remediation, and applyOnce fail for that resource.

claims.claim: The calling app needs delegated ConfigurationMonitoring.ReadWrite.All for applyOnce.
claims.quote: Creating an applyOnce monitor supports delegated permissions only. In addition to the calling app's delegated ConfigurationMonitoring.ReadWrite.All permission, the TCM service principal needs delegated permissions for the target workloads

claims.claim: The TCM service principal needs delegated CopilotPolicySettings.ReadWrite for remediation and applyOnce.
claims.quote: For remediation and applyOnce, grant it the CopilotPolicySettings.ReadWrite delegated permission.

claims.claim: The signed-in user needs the AI Administrator role for this applyOnce automation.
claims.quote: For remediation and applyOnce, AI Administrator is the least-privileged Microsoft Entra role for the signed-in user. This role requirement applies to the user, not to the TCM service principal.

claims.claim: This automation is preview Microsoft Graph beta, whose use in production applications is not supported.
claims.quote: APIs under the /beta version in Microsoft Graph are subject to change. Use of these APIs in production applications is not supported.

claims.claim: The supplied feature descriptions describe added file types, not changes to sign-in, roles or connectors.
claims.quote: We are introducing support for using CSV and TSV files as knowledge sources in Microsoft Copilot Notebooks. This enhancement allows users to add structured lists and tabular data directly to notebooks alongside existing document types.

claims.claim: The notice describes user-added reference files and content generation, not autonomous behaviour.
claims.quote:
Users will be able to add CSV and TSV files as knowledge sources in Copilot Notebooks.
Copilot will use data contained in these files alongside other referenced content when generating responses and content.
